entities.name: Dual Monarchy & Budapest's Golden Age
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Compromise gave Hungary self-government. Budapest was unified (1873), the Hungarian Parliament building constructed, the Millennium celebrations (1896), and rapid industrial and cultural development made Budapest a major European capital.
